data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that fetches and displays web link previews with customization and caching.
data.what_it_does: The package parses a URL to extract metadata using HTML, Open Graph, JSON‑LD and Twitter Card parsers. It then renders a customizable preview card and caches the metadata for faster subsequent loads.
use_when: Displaying link previews in chat or messaging UIs
Needing a highly customizable preview widget with optional image/SVG support
avoid_when: Complex backend data aggregation beyond simple link metadata
When you need fine‑grained network control beyond the provided fetch logic
strengths: Extensive customization of appearance and behavior
Supports SVG images and custom User‑Agent strings
Robust error handling and placeholder widgets
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter apps; not a pure networking library
Caching relies on shared_preferences which may not suit all storage needs
May require tweaking User‑Agent or proxy for some sites
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency, import the package, ensure internet permission on Android/iOS (default), optionally configure shared_preferences for caching

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level HTTP requests so you can implement a custom link preview without extra widget overhead
